section: i) Aadhaar based DBT ensures that nobody else can claim your benefits by impersonating you. ii) In case of cash transfers, the money reaches directly to your DBT enabled bank account of your choice. iii) Benefits under different schemes for which you have enrolled, are transferred only to DBT enabled bank account of your choice.
